page: Microsoft Azure E8ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is equipped with an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor operating at 3.7 GHz, delivering 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The CPU cache architecture includes 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX-512 with support for VNNI and BF16, alongside cryptographic acceleration features such as AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. It does not include dedicated graphics processing units.

Hardware allocation includes 64.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio with 8.0 GB per virtual core. Local storage is provided through a 472 GB NVMe SSD, suitable for temporary storage, local caching, and swap operations alongside Premium Storage support. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results highlight strong single-threaded CPU capability, scoring 3080.38 in stress-ng and 1938.0 in Geekbench single-core evaluations. Text processing performance is also in the top tier at 2646.0 points. Multi-core performance aligns with expected midrange metrics for an 8-vCPU configuration, recording 12321.11 in stress-ng and 7474.0 in Geekbench. Cached memory read bandwidth is steady at 607.78 GB/sec, though uncached large-block read operations register lower at 37.68 GB/sec. In application-focused metrics, Redis SET operations reached 11.53 million operations per second, while static web serving throughput measured 12.17 GB/sec.

The 8:1 memory configuration makes the E8ads_v6 cost-effective for workloads where high memory density is paramount relative to raw core counts. However, memory bandwidth on large uncached datasets and prompt processing on 7B parameter language models exhibit weaker throughput. This instance is best aligned with in-memory caching systems, relational databases requiring substantial buffer pools, data warehousing, and enterprise applications requiring high memory per thread.
description: Microsoft Azure E8ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running at 3.7 GHz on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system provides 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores, 64.0 GB of memory (8.0 GB per vCPU), and a local 472 GB NVMe SSD, operating without a discrete GPU. In benchmark testing, the instance exhibits strong single-core CPU throughput, reaching 3080.38 in stress-ng and 1938.0 in Geekbench single-core, alongside a high text-processing rating. Multi-threaded compute, compression, and Redis operations demonstrate reliable midrange results. While large uncached memory reads present lower throughput, its memory-dense architecture offers high efficiency for memory-bound tasks. The E8ads_v6 is suited for in-memory databases, relational database management systems, data processing, and mid-tier enterprise software.
